import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import os

# File paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SAMPLE_PATH = "./input/sample_submission_null.csv"
SUB_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUB_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_df = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_PATH)


# Text cleaning function
def clean_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return text.strip().strip('"').replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", "").lower()
    return ""


train_df["clean"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["clean"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Stratified train/validation split (strict hold-out for evaluation)
X_train_raw, X_val_raw, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["clean"],
    train_df["Insult"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["Insult"],
)

# Vectorization setup
word_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word", ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, max_features=25000
)
char_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 5), min_df=2, max_features=25000
)

# Fit on training split only, transform all sets
X_train_words = word_vec.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_train_chars = char_vec.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_val_words = word_vec.transform(X_val_raw)
X_val_chars = char_vec.transform(X_val_raw)
X_test_words = word_vec.transform(test_df["clean"])
X_test_chars = char_vec.transform(test_df["clean"])


# Feature extraction for stylistic cues
def extract_stylistic_features(series):
    feats = []
    for txt in series:
        length = len(txt) if txt else 1
        upper_ratio = sum(1 for c in txt if c.isupper()) / length
        excl_density = txt.count("!") / length
        q_mark_density = txt.count("?") / length
        feats.append([length, upper_ratio, excl_density, q_mark_density])
    return np.array(feats)


X_train_style = extract_stylistic_features(X_train_raw)
X_val_style = extract_stylistic_features(X_val_raw)
X_test_style = extract_stylistic_features(test_df["clean"])

# Scale stylistic features
style_scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_style_scaled = style_scaler.fit_transform(X_train_style)
X_val_style_scaled = style_scaler.transform(X_val_style)
X_test_style_scaled = style_scaler.transform(X_test_style)

# Convert to sparse and stack with TF-IDF
X_train = hstack([X_train_words, X_train_chars, csr_matrix(X_train_style_scaled)])
X_val = hstack([X_val_words, X_val_chars, csr_matrix(X_val_style_scaled)])
X_test = hstack([X_test_words, X_test_chars, csr_matrix(X_test_style_scaled)])

# Model Training
clf = LogisticRegression(
    class_weight="balanced", max_iter=1000, solver="liblinear", random_state=42
)
clf.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validation Evaluation
val_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Test Prediction & Submission
test_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
sub_df = sample_df.copy()
sub_df["Insult"] = test_probs
sub_df.to_csv(os.path.join(SUB_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully.")
